high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from a news website about the 2024 British Academy of Film and Television Arts (BAFTA) Awards. The headline reads: "BAFTA 2024: Deepika Padukone presents Jonathan Glazer Best Film Award not in the English language for The Zone Of Interest." The article mentions that Deepika Padukone attended the 77th BAFTA Awards in 2024, wearing a glamorous sequin saree. She was praised online for her choice of attire, which is described as Indian clothing. The author of the article is Loveleen Kaur
